title: CodeMark: Imperceptible Watermarking for Code Datasets against Neural Code Completion Models
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The research focuses on a method called CodeMark for imperceptibly watermarking code datasets to protect them against unauthorized use in training neural code completion models. The findings demonstrate that this method is harmless to model accuracy, verifiable, robust, and imperceptible to both human and automated detection.
